Name: Change Combat Difficulty
Author: blueOstrich
Description:
[u]Difficulties[/u]: 
[b]No damage: [/b]Monsters are significantly slower, have much less health and defense, and give no damage. Gives a stress-free mining experience while still allowing the player to collect the rewards associated with slaying monsters. [b] 
Easy[/b]: Monsters are significantly slower, have much less health and defense, give very little damage, and have a possibility of missing during attack. Their stats are around 10% of default. 
[b]Medium[/b]: Monsters are a little slower; and have lower health, defense, and damage. They also have a small possibility of missing while attacking. Their stats are around 75% of default. 
[b]Hard[/b]: Default monster stats
[b]Extra hard[/b]: Monsters are significantly faster, have higher health, defense, and damage. Their stats are 50% higher than default.

Manifest.Name: Change Combat Difficulty
Manifest.Description: Lets the player adjust the combat difficulty to one of five levels. It changes the stats of the monsters, making them more or less challenging to fight.
Manifest.Author: Blue Ostrich
